label: TP
reason: Both alerts indicate vulnerabilities. The SQL injection alert (java/sql-injection) has a resolved sink value that depends on user input. The XSS alert (java/xss) also has a resolved sink value that depends on user input despite encoding.

evidence.note: SQL injection vulnerability detected due to user-provided value being directly inserted into the SQL query.
XSS vulnerability detected due to user-provided value being used in the HTML output despite encoding.
